verdict.rationale: Wise documents card-level controls that are enforced automatically: rules by merchant category code or transaction currency, plus toggles for channels such as e-commerce, ATM and contactless. Nothing in the evidence shows budgets set per department or program, or monetary spend caps. missing for 10: department/program budget objects, amount-based spend limits enforced against a budget, team or department grouping of cards, budget tracking/reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
